name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.0.4
body:
## Features / 主要更新

- Keyboard navigation for the desktop action menu with Arrow keys, Enter, Escape, Alt, and F10. / 桌面操作菜单支持方向键、Enter、Escape、Alt 和 F10 键盘导航。
- Copy Diagnostics exports runtime, workspace, and recent startup information to the clipboard. / “复制排障信息”会将运行时、工作区和最近启动信息复制到剪贴板。
- Clear Web Storage removes local UI caches and storage after confirmation, then restarts the app. / “清理本地缓存与存储”经确认后清理界面缓存和本地存储，并重启应用。

## Improvements / 优化提升

- Action feedback appears in a lightweight in-app toast after desktop diagnostics actions. / 桌面排障操作完成后，在应用内显示轻量反馈提示。
- The storage cleanup flow keeps login cookies while clearing application caches and IndexedDB data. / 清理流程保留登录 cookies，同时清除应用缓存和 IndexedDB 数据。

## Fixes / 修复

- Desktop menu focus is reset when the menu closes or dispatches an action, preventing stale focus state. / 菜单关闭或执行操作后会重置焦点，避免残留旧的焦点状态。
